0.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_000
0.description: This is Maelstrom Command, headquarters of Limsa Lominsa's Grand Company. Our doors are open to all who would fight on the side of order and justice.
0.translation_description: Qui è il Comando della Tempesta, quartier generale della Grande Compagnia di Limsa Lominsa. Le nostre porte sono aperte a chiunque voglia combattere per l'ordine e la giustizia.

1.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_001
1.description: You are come to the Adders' Nest, command center of the Order of the Twin Adder. Ever do we welcome they who would toil in the elementals' name for the survival and well-being of our forest nation.
1.translation_description: Ti trovi nel Nido delle Vipere, centro di comando dell'Ordine della Vipera Gemella. Accogliamo sempre chi si adopera in nome degli elementali per la sopravvivenza e il benessere della nostra nazione boschiva.

2.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_002
2.description: You stand within the Hall of Flames, the burning heart of operations for the Immortal Flames. We're always seeking kindred souls possessed of unquenchable spirit to join our cause.
2.translation_description: Ti trovi nella Sala delle Fiamme, cuore ardente delle operazioni delle Fiamme Immortali. Cerchiamo sempre persone affini a noi, animate da uno spirito inesauribile e pronte a unirsi alla nostra causa.

3.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_003
3.description: I commend your enthusiasm, but the Maelstrom has no need of one so raw. Come back when you have forged a reputation for yourself.
3.translation_description: Apprezzo il tuo entusiasmo, ma la Tempesta non ha bisogno di reclute così inesperte. Torna quando avrai costruito una reputazione.

4.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_004
4.description: While your zeal cannot be denied, you must grow stronger if you are to entwine your destiny with ours. Prove you have the fortitude to weather the fiercest of storms, and then return here.
4.translation_description: Il tuo zelo è innegabile, ma devi diventare più forte prima di unire il tuo destino al nostro. Dimostra di saper resistere alle tempeste più violente, poi torna.

5.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_005
5.description: I sense something of a fire within you, but it flickers as candlelight. Stoke this inner fire till it becomes a raging inferno, and we can speak again of your part in the Immortal Flames.
5.translation_description: Sento in te una scintilla, ma per ora è fioca come la fiamma di una candela. Alimentala finché non diventerà un incendio devastante, poi riparleremo del tuo possibile ingresso nelle Fiamme Immortali.

6.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_006
6.description: In order to join a Grand Company, you must progress further in the main scenario.
6.translation_description: Per unirti a una Grande Compagnia, devi proseguire con la storia principale.

7.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_007
7.description: This is Maelstrom Command, headquarters of Limsa Lominsa's Grand Company.
7.translation_description: Qui è il Comando della Tempesta, quartier generale della Grande Compagnia di Limsa Lominsa.

8.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_007
8.description: If you have no business being here, then begone.
8.translation_description: Se non hai motivo di essere qui, vattene.

9.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_008
9.description: You are come to the Adders' Nest, command center of the Order of the Twin Adder.
9.translation_description: Ti trovi nel Nido delle Vipere, centro di comando dell'Ordine della Vipera Gemella.

10.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_100_008
10.description: If you haven't reason to be here, pray take your leave.
10.translation_description: Se non hai ragioni per essere qui, ti prego di andartene.

11.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_009
11.description: You stand within the Hall of Flames, the burning heart of operations for the Immortal Flames.
11.translation_description: Ti trovi nella Sala delle Fiamme, cuore ardente delle operazioni delle Fiamme Immortali.

12.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_100_009
12.description: Unless you've pertinent matters to discuss, I suggest that you remove yourself from these premises.
12.translation_description: Se non hai questioni pertinenti da discutere, ti consiglio di lasciare questi locali.

13.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_010
13.description: Records indicate that you are currently enlisted with another Grand Company. If you have a mind to take up the Maelstrom cause, however, your application for transfer would be most welcome.
13.translation_description: Dai registri risulta che al momento fai parte di un'altra Grande Compagnia. Se però vuoi schierarti con la Tempesta, accoglieremo volentieri la tua richiesta di trasferimento.

14.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_011
14.description: According to Alliance records, you are presently enlisted with another Grand Company. If you would take the wood's will for your own, however, your application for transfer would be most welcome.
14.translation_description: Dai registri dell'Alleanza risulta che al momento fai parte di un'altra Grande Compagnia. Se desideri abbracciare la volontà del bosco, accoglieremo con piacere la tua richiesta di trasferimento.

15.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_012
15.description: Alliance records indicate that you are currently enlisted with another Grand Company. If you wish to burn with the Immortal Flames, however, your application for transfer would be most welcome.
15.translation_description: Dai registri dell'Alleanza risulta che al momento fai parte di un'altra Grande Compagnia. Se desideri ardere insieme alle Fiamme Immortali, accoglieremo con piacere la tua richiesta di trasferimento.

16.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_Q1_000
16.description: What do you wish to do?

19.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_013
19.description: Hmmm, it appears you have only recently transferred to your current Grand Company. Alliance regulations require that you wait <hex:020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303> more <hex:020810E4E80202FF04646179FF056461797303> before submitting an application.
19.translation_description: Hmm... a quanto pare hai cambiato Grande Compagnia da poco. Le regole dell'Alleanza impongono di attendere ancora <hex:020863E802FF57020853E2E8020BFF45020941E802FF03756EFF04647565FF04747265FF087175617474726FFF0763696E717565FF04736569FF067365747465FF056F74746FFF056E6F7665FF06646965636903FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303> <hex:020815E4E80202FF0767696F726E6FFF0767696F726E6903> prima di presentare una nuova richiesta.

20.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_014
20.description: Ah, it would seem you have but recently transferred to your present Grand Company. Begging your pardons, but Alliance regulations require that <hex:020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303> more <hex:020810E4E80202FF04646179FF056461797303> must pass before your application may be considered.
20.translation_description: Ah, vedo che hai cambiato Grande Compagnia da poco. Mi dispiace, ma le regole dell'Alleanza impongono di attendere ancora <hex:020863E802FF57020853E2E8020BFF45020941E802FF03756EFF04647565FF04747265FF087175617474726FFF0763696E717565FF04736569FF067365747465FF056F74746FFF056E6F7665FF06646965636903FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303> <hex:020815E4E80202FF0767696F726E6FFF0767696F726E6903> prima che la tua richiesta possa essere esaminata.

21.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_015
21.description: ...Hm? Why, have you not only recently transferred to your current Grand Company? I'm afraid Alliance regulations require that you wait <hex:020860E802FF54020850E2E8020BFF4202093EE802FF046F6E65FF0474776FFF067468726565FF05666F7572FF0566697665FF04736978FF06736576656EFF066569676874FF056E696E65FF0474656E03FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303> more <hex:020810E4E80202FF04646179FF056461797303> before submitting an application.
21.translation_description: ...Eh? Ma non hai cambiato Grande Compagnia da poco? Temo che le regole dell'Alleanza impongano di attendere ancora <hex:020863E802FF57020853E2E8020BFF45020941E802FF03756EFF04647565FF04747265FF087175617474726FFF0763696E717565FF04736569FF067365747465FF056F74746FFF056E6F7665FF06646965636903FF07022003E8020303FF07022003E8020303> <hex:020815E4E80202FF0767696F726E6FFF0767696F726E6903> prima di presentare una nuova richiesta.

22.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_016
22.description: After transferring to another Grand Company, a certain amount of time must elapse before you can apply for another transfer.
22.translation_description: Dopo aver cambiato Grande Compagnia, deve trascorrere un certo periodo prima che tu possa richiedere un nuovo trasferimento.

23.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_017
23.description: At the time of application, you must not be equipped with any gear issued by your current Grand Company of allegiance.
23.translation_description: Quando presenti la richiesta, non devi indossare equipaggiamento fornito dalla Grande Compagnia a cui appartieni.

24.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_018
24.description: Furthermore, if you have a promotion trial in progress, it must first be abandoned.
24.translation_description: Inoltre, se hai una prova di promozione in corso, devi prima abbandonarla.

25.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_019
25.description: The same applies for Grand Company levequests, which must all be abandoned.
25.translation_description: Lo stesso vale per i Mandati delle Grandi Compagnie: devi abbandonarli tutti.

26.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_020
26.description: It appears you are still wearing <hex:02082EE1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF1D020819E1E93601FF0B5477696E204164646572FF07466C616D65730303>-issue equipment. If you would begin anew with us, you must be prepared to let go of the past. Remove all trace of your current Grand Company from your person, and let us speak again.
26.translation_description: Stai ancora indossando equipaggiamento <hex:02084DE1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF37020833E1E93601FF1564656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C690303>. Se vuoi ricominciare da zero con noi, dovrai lasciarti il passato alle spalle. Rimuovi ogni traccia della tua attuale Grande Compagnia e torna a parlarmi.

27.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_021
27.description: Ah, it would seem you are still wearing <hex:02082EE1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF1D020819E1E93601FF0B5477696E204164646572FF07466C616D65730303>-issue equipment. If you would turn a new leaf with our Order, you must be prepared to relinquish the past. Pray remove every relic of your current Grand Company from your person, and present yourself to me once more.
27.translation_description: Ah, a quanto pare indossi ancora equipaggiamento <hex:02084DE1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF37020833E1E93601FF1564656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C690303>. Se vuoi voltare pagina ed entrare nel nostro Ordine, dovrai lasciarti il passato alle spalle. Togli ogni segno della tua attuale Grande Compagnia e torna a parlarmi.

28.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_022
28.description: You are still wearing <hex:02082EE1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF1D020819E1E93601FF0B5477696E204164646572FF07466C616D65730303>-issue equipment. If you truly wish to be one of us, you must forsake all past associations. Remove all trace of your current Grand Company from your person, and we may speak again.
28.translation_description: Indossi ancora equipaggiamento <hex:02084DE1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF37020833E1E93601FF1564656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C690303>. Se vuoi davvero unirti a noi, dovrai rinunciare a ogni legame precedente. Rimuovi ogni traccia della tua attuale Grande Compagnia e torneremo a parlarne.

29.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_023
29.description: It appears you are in the midst of a task for your current company. Alliance regulations forbid me from accepting your request at this time.
29.translation_description: Dai registri risulta che sei ancora impegnato in un incarico della tua Compagnia. Le regole dell'Alleanza mi impediscono di accettare la tua richiesta in questo momento.

30.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_023
30.description: Though you may be loath to do so, you must first abandon the said task before we can speak of transfers.
30.translation_description: Anche se ti dispiace, dovrai prima abbandonare quell'incarico per poter parlare di trasferimento.

31.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_024
31.description: Ah, it would seem you are in the midst of active duty for your current company. Begging your pardons, but accepting your request would infringe upon Alliance regulations.
31.translation_description: A quanto pare sei ancora in servizio attivo per la tua Compagnia. Mi dispiace, ma accettare la tua richiesta violerebbe le regole dell'Alleanza.

32.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_024
32.description: If we are to proceed with your transfer, you must first abandon the said duty, difficult though the decision may be.
32.translation_description: Per procedere con il trasferimento, devi prima abbandonare l'incarico, anche se la decisione può essere difficile.

33.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_025
33.description: Hm? You are in the middle of a task for your current organization, it seems. In which case, I cannot accept your request for transfer─so do Alliance regulations stipulate.
33.translation_description: Eh? A quanto pare sei nel bel mezzo di un incarico per la tua organizzazione. Le regole dell'Alleanza non mi consentono di accettare la tua richiesta di trasferimento.

34.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_025
34.description: If you wish to proceed with your transfer, you are required to first abandon the said task.
34.translation_description: Per procedere con il trasferimento, devi prima abbandonare l'incarico.

35.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_150_023
35.description: It appears you are short of the coin needed for the transfer. Speak with me again when you have sufficient funds.
35.translation_description: Per poter ottenere una promozione, dovrai completare le missioni della Grande Compagnia e dimostrare la tua dedizione alla causa.

36.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_150_024
36.description: Transferring your allegiance requires a payment in gil. Regrettably, it would seem you have not sufficient funds to complete the procedure.
36.translation_description: Il trasferimento richiede un pagamento in gil. Purtroppo non hai abbastanza denaro per completare la procedura.

37.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_150_025
37.description: It appears you lack the coin to pay for the transfer. Muster the required funds, then return here once more.
37.translation_description: Non hai abbastanza gil per pagare il trasferimento. Procurati la somma necessaria e poi torna qui.

38.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_026
38.description: Excellent! You would be a most welcome addition to the Maelstrom!
38.translation_description: Ottimo! La Tempesta sarà lieta di accoglierti!

39.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_026
39.description: Now, according to our records, this is your very first transfer. The transfer fee will be waived this time only.
39.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che questo è il tuo primo trasferimento. In questo caso, non dovrai pagare alcuna quota.

40.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_027
40.description: I should be pleased to welcome you as a <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203> of the Order!
40.translation_description: È un piacere accoglierti nell'Ordine come <hex:020816E905FF08736F72656C6C61FF0966726174656C6C6F03>!

41.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_027
41.description: Now, our records indicate that you are transferring for the first time. As such, I am pleased to inform you that the transfer fee will be waived.
41.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che è il tuo primo trasferimento. Per questo, ti comunico con piacere che non dovrai pagare alcuna quota.

43.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_028
43.description: Now, seeing as this is your very first transfer, I will waive the registration fee.
43.translation_description: Visto che è il tuo primo trasferimento, ti esento dalla quota di registrazione.

44.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_029
44.description: Please be warned: upon switching allegiance, you will be unable to equip items issued by your previous Grand Company.
44.translation_description: Attenzione: dopo aver cambiato affiliazione, non potrai più equipaggiare gli oggetti forniti dalla tua precedente Grande Compagnia.

45.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_090_029
45.description: Moreover, PvP EXP and PvP rank obtained as a member of your previous Grand Company will no longer be recognized.
45.translation_description: Inoltre, non verranno più riconosciuti l'esperienza PvP e il grado PvP ottenuti presso la tua precedente Grande Compagnia.

46.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_091_029
46.description: However, these PvP rewards will not be lost; they will be retained.
46.translation_description: Tuttavia, non perderai queste ricompense PvP: resteranno tue.

47.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_092_029
47.description: Should you elect to reenlist in a Grand Company, any previously obtained PvP rewards will be recognized once more.
47.translation_description: Se un giorno ti arruolerai di nuovo in una Grande Compagnia, tutte le ricompense PvP ottenute in precedenza verranno nuovamente riconosciute.

48.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_110_029
48.description: Conversely, all adventurer squadron data is carried over when you switch allegiance.
48.translation_description: Per contro, tutti i dati della tua squadra di avventurieri verranno conservati quando cambierai affiliazione.

49.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_111_029
49.description: Until you reach the rank of second lieutenant in your new Grand Company, however, you will be unable to enter the squadron barracks.
49.translation_description: Tuttavia, non potrai accedere alla caserma della squadra finché non raggiungerai il grado di Sottotenente nella nuova Grande Compagnia.

50.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_100_029
50.description: Please note that once you have switched allegiances, you may not do so again for fifteen days (Earth time).
50.translation_description: Dopo aver cambiato affiliazione, non potrai farlo di nuovo per 15 giorni (ora terrestre).

51.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_101_029
51.description: Finally, be advised that a registration fee of 50,000 gil is required for all but the first transfer.
51.translation_description: Infine, sappi che tutti i trasferimenti successivi al primo prevedono una quota di registrazione di 50.000 gil.

55.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_031
55.description: Congratulations! You are now officially a soldier of the Maelstrom!
55.translation_description: Complimenti! Ora sei ufficialmente un soldato della Tempesta!

56.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_031
56.description: May you serve Limsa Lominsa well, till sea swallows all.
56.translation_description: Possano i tuoi servigi onorare Limsa Lominsa, finché il mare non inghiottirà tutto.

57.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_032
57.description: In the sight of the elementals, I welcome you to the Order of the Twin Adder.
57.translation_description: Alla vista degli elementali, ti do il benvenuto nell'Ordine della Vipera Gemella.

58.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_032
58.description: Go forth and do that which brings peace to the Twelveswood and honor to our name.
58.translation_description: Vai e porta pace nel Bosco dei Dodici, facendo onore al nostro nome.

59.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_033
59.description: Be welcome to the Immortal Flames!
59.translation_description: Ti diamo il benvenuto tra le Fiamme Immortali!

60.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_033
60.description: May you fight to the last for coin and country!
60.translation_description: Combatti fino all'ultimo per la tua patria e per la paga!

61.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_034
61.description: Transferring to the Maelstrom incurs a fee. Are you willing to pay this?
61.translation_description: Il trasferimento alla Tempesta prevede il pagamento di una quota. Accetti di pagarla?

62.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_035
62.description: Please be informed that the act of transferring allegiance incurs a fee. Are you willing to bear the cost?
62.translation_description: Il trasferimento richiede il pagamento di una quota. Accetti di pagarla?

63.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_036
63.description: Transferring to the Immortal Flames requires that you pay a fee. Knowing this, are you willing to proceed?
63.translation_description: Per trasferirti alle Fiamme Immortali devi pagare una quota. Accetti di procedere?

64.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_Q3_000
64.translation_description: Per poter ottenere una promozione, dovrai completare le missioni della Grande Compagnia e dimostrare la tua dedizione alla causa.

67.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_Q4_000
67.description: What do you wish to do?

70.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_A4_003
70.description: Ask about missions and company seals.
70.translation_description: Informazioni sulle missioni e sui sigilli di compagnia.

72.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_037
72.description: The Maelstrom recognizes your service, but currently there are no further ranks available to you.
72.translation_description: La Tempesta riconosce il tuo servizio, ma al momento non ci sono altri gradi a tua disposizione.

73.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_038
73.description: My apologies, but you have reached the maximum allowable rank.
73.translation_description: Mi dispiace, ma hai raggiunto il grado massimo.

74.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_039
74.description: Bright as your flame may burn, there are no further promotions available to you.
74.translation_description: La tua fiamma brilla intensa, ma non ci sono altre promozioni disponibili.

75.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_040
75.description: For this, you must receive the express endorsement of Commander R'ashaht Rhiki.
75.translation_description: Per questo devi ottenere l'approvazione esplicita del Comandante R'ashaht Rhiki.

76.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_041
76.description: For further promotion, you must needs meet with the satisfaction of Commander Vorsaile Heuloix.
76.translation_description: Per ottenere un'altra promozione, devi soddisfare il Comandante Vorsaile Heuloix.

77.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_042
77.description: To be considered for the next rank, you must prove yourself in the eyes of Commander Swift.
77.translation_description: Per aspirare al grado successivo, devi dimostrare il tuo valore al Comandante Swift.

78.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_043
78.description: ...Hmmm, so you have fulfilled all of the commander's requirements. Without further ado, I shall make the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
78.translation_description: Dunque, hai soddisfatto tutti i requisiti del comandante. Procedo subito a organizzare la tua promozione.

79.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_044
79.description: Ah, yes, you have met with the satisfaction of the commander. It would be my pleasure to see to the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
79.translation_description: A quanto pare il comandante ti ha dato la sua approvazione. Mi occuperò volentieri di predisporre la tua promozione.

80.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_045
80.description: I see you have met with the commander's approval. Very well, I shall to see to the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
80.translation_description: Vedo che hai ottenuto l'approvazione del comandante. D'accordo, mi occuperò di predisporre la tua promozione.

81.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_046
81.description: The commander stands to my left. Speak with her to learn what you must do to win her approval.
81.translation_description: Il comandante è alla mia sinistra. Parla con lei per sapere che cosa devi fare per ottenere la sua approvazione.

82.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_047
82.description: You will find the good commander standing yonder. Request of him his endorsement, and he will assign you a trial by which you may earn it.
82.translation_description: Troverai il comandante laggiù. Chiedigli di approvarti: ti assegnerà una prova per guadagnartela.

83.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_048
83.description: The commander is here at the Hall of Flames. Speak with him to learn how you might go about proving your worth.
83.translation_description: Per poter ottenere una promozione, dovrai completare le missioni della Grande Compagnia e dimostrare la tua dedizione alla causa.

84.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_049
84.description: To qualify for your next promotion, you must complete rank <hex:022003E80203> in the Grand Company objectives of your hunting log.
84.translation_description: Per ottenere la prossima promozione, devi completare il rango <hex:022003E80203> degli obiettivi delle Grandi Compagnie nel Registro di Caccia.

85.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_050
85.description: In order to receive your next promotion, you must complete rank <hex:022003E80203> in the Grand Company objectives of your hunting log.
85.translation_description: Per ricevere la prossima promozione, devi completare il rango <hex:022003E80203> degli obiettivi delle Grandi Compagnie nel Registro di Caccia.

86.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_051
86.description: To qualify for your next promotion, you must complete rank <hex:022003E80203> in the Grand Company objectives of your hunting log.
86.translation_description: Per ottenere la prossima promozione, devi completare il rango <hex:022003E80203> degli obiettivi delle Grandi Compagnie nel Registro di Caccia.

87.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_052
87.description: I see that you have already done so. Very well, I shall make the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
87.translation_description: Vedo che l'hai già fatto. Benissimo, predisporrò la tua promozione.

88.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_053
88.description: It appears that you have already fulfilled this requirement. I should be pleased to make the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
88.translation_description: A quanto pare hai già soddisfatto questo requisito. Mi occuperò volentieri di predisporre la tua promozione.

89.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_054
89.description: I see you have already done so. Very well, I shall make the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
89.translation_description: Vedo che l'hai già fatto. D'accordo, predisporrò la tua promozione.

90.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_055
90.description: According to our records, you have yet to do so. Let us speak again when you have fulfilled this requirement.
90.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che non hai ancora completato questo requisito. Riparliamone quando l'avrai soddisfatto.

91.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_056
91.description: Alas, it would seem you have yet to fulfill this requirement. Pray return here when the feat is accomplished.
91.translation_description: Ahimè, non hai ancora soddisfatto questo requisito. Torna quando avrai compiuto l'impresa.

92.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_057
92.description: Our records show that this feat eludes you still. Let us speak again when you have achieved the requisite rank.
92.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che non hai ancora raggiunto il grado necessario. Riparliamone quando l'avrai raggiunto.

93.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_058
93.description: To qualify for your next promotion, you must complete a trial as well as complete rank <hex:022003E80203> in the Grand Company objectives of your hunting log.
93.translation_description: Per ottenere la prossima promozione, devi superare una prova e completare il rango <hex:022003E80203> degli obiettivi delle Grandi Compagnie nel Registro di Caccia.

94.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_059
94.description: In order to receive your next promotion, not only must you complete a trial, but you are also required to complete rank <hex:022003E80203> in the Grand Company objectives of your hunting log.
94.translation_description: Per ricevere la prossima promozione, devi superare una prova e completare il rango <hex:022003E80203> degli obiettivi delle Grandi Compagnie nel Registro di Caccia.

95.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_060
95.description: To qualify for your next promotion, you must complete a trial as well as complete rank <hex:022003E80203> in the Grand Company objectives of your hunting log.
95.translation_description: Per ottenere la prossima promozione, devi superare una prova e completare il rango <hex:022003E80203> degli obiettivi delle Grandi Compagnie nel Registro di Caccia.

96.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_061
96.description: I see that you have already accomplished both. Very well, I shall make the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
96.translation_description: Vedo che hai già soddisfatto entrambi i requisiti. Benissimo, predisporrò la tua promozione.

97.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_062
97.description: It appears that you have already fulfilled both requirements. I should be pleased to make the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
97.translation_description: A quanto pare hai già soddisfatto entrambi i requisiti. Mi occuperò volentieri di predisporre la tua promozione.

98.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_063
98.description: I see you have already done so. Very well, I shall make the necessary arrangements for your promotion.
98.translation_description: Vedo che hai già soddisfatto i requisiti. D'accordo, predisporrò la tua promozione.

99.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_064
99.description: According to our records, you have yet to fulfill the commander's requirements. I recommend you speak with her to receive your trial.
99.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che non hai ancora soddisfatto i requisiti del comandante. Parlale per ricevere una prova.

100.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_065
100.description: Alas, it would seem you have yet to meet the commander's satisfaction. Might I suggest you seek him out to receive your trial?
100.translation_description: Ahimè, non hai ancora ottenuto l'approvazione del comandante. Ti consiglio di cercarlo per ricevere una prova.

101.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_066
101.description: Our records show that you have yet to receive the commander's approval. You would do well to seek him out to be assigned a trial.
101.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che non hai ancora ottenuto l'approvazione del comandante. Ti conviene cercarlo per farti assegnare una prova.

102.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_067
102.description: According to our records, you have yet to fulfill the latter. Let us speak again when you have done so.
102.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che non hai ancora soddisfatto il secondo requisito. Riparliamone quando l'avrai fatto.

103.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_068
103.description: Alas, it would seem you have yet to fulfill the latter. Pray return here when the feat is accomplished.
103.translation_description: Ahimè, non hai ancora soddisfatto il secondo requisito. Torna quando avrai compiuto l'impresa.

104.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_069
104.description: Our records show that the second feat eludes you still. Let us speak again when you have achieved the requisite rank.
104.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che non hai ancora completato il secondo requisito. Riparliamone quando avrai raggiunto il grado necessario.

105.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_070
105.description: According to our records, you have fulfilled...neither! You have some work ahead of you still, soldier.
105.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che non hai soddisfatto nessuno dei due requisiti. Hai ancora parecchio lavoro da fare.

106.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_071
106.description: Alas, it would seem you have yet to fulfill either requirement. Pray return here when both feats are accomplished.
106.translation_description: Ahimè, non hai ancora soddisfatto nessuno dei due requisiti. Torna dopo aver compiuto entrambe le imprese.

107.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_072
107.description: Our records show that both feats elude you still. If you desire that promotion, best you put your nose to the grindstone.
107.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che non hai ancora soddisfatto nessuno dei due requisiti. Se vuoi la promozione, rimboccati le maniche.

108.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_073
108.description: You are currently <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. To qualify for <hex:022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E8060103>, you must fulfill the following requirements:
108.translation_description: Il tuo grado attuale è <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. Per accedere al grado <hex:022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E8060103>, devi soddisfare i requisiti seguenti:

109.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_074
109.description: Your present rank is <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103>. In order to be promoted to <hex:02281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E8060103>, you must fulfill the following requirements:
109.translation_description: Il tuo grado attuale è <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103>. Per avanzare al grado <hex:02281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E8060103>, devi soddisfare i requisiti seguenti:

110.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_075
110.description: Your current rank is <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. If you wish to become <hex:022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E8060103>, you must fulfill the following requirements:
110.translation_description: Il tuo grado attuale è <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. Se vuoi diventare <hex:022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E8060103>, devi soddisfare i requisiti seguenti:

111.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_076
111.description: In the name of the Admiral, I hereby appoint you to the rank of <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. May you ever serve the best interests of Limsa Lominsa, till sea swallows all!
111.translation_description: Nel nome dell'Ammiraglio, ti nomino al grado di <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. Che tu possa sempre servire gli interessi di Limsa Lominsa, finché il mare non inghiottirà tutto!

112.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_077
112.description: In the sight of the elementals, I hereby confer upon you the rank of <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103> and all rights and privileges associated with the title. Go forth and do that which brings peace to the Twelveswood and honor to our name.
112.translation_description: Alla vista degli elementali, ti conferisco il grado di <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103> e tutti i diritti e i privilegi associati al titolo. Va' e porta pace nel Bosco dei Dodici, facendo onore al nostro nome.

113.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_078
113.description: By the power vested in me, I hereby appoint you to the rank of <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. May you fight to the last for coin and country!
113.translation_description: In virtù dei poteri conferitimi, ti nomino al grado di <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. Combatti fino all'ultimo per la patria e per la paga!

114.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_079
114.description: In the name of the Admiral, I hereby appoint you to the rank of <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. By this promotion, you are now eligible to undertake expert delivery missions.
114.translation_description: Nel nome dell'Ammiraglio, ti nomino al grado di <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. Questa promozione ti consente di accettare Missioni di Consegna Speciali.

115.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_079
115.description: May you ever serve the best interests of Limsa Lominsa, till sea swallows all!
115.translation_description: Che tu possa sempre servire gli interessi di Limsa Lominsa, finché il mare non inghiottirà tutto!

116.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_080
116.description: In the sight of the elementals, I hereby confer upon you the rank of <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103>. I am pleased to inform you that, as of this moment, you are eligible to undertake expert delivery missions.
116.translation_description: Alla vista degli elementali, ti conferisco il grado di <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103>. Ti comunico con piacere che da oggi puoi accettare Missioni di Consegna Speciali.

117.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_100_080
117.description: Go forth and do that which brings peace to the Twelveswood and honor to our name.
117.translation_description: Va' e porta pace nel Bosco dei Dodici, facendo onore al nostro nome.

118.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_081
118.description: By the power vested in me, I hereby appoint you to the rank of <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. By this promotion, you are now eligible to undertake expert delivery missions.
118.translation_description: In virtù dei poteri conferitimi, ti nomino al grado di <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. Questa promozione ti consente di accettare Missioni di Consegna Speciali.

119.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_100_081
119.description: May you fight to the last for coin and country!
119.translation_description: Combatti fino all'ultimo per la patria e per la paga!

120.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_082
120.description: In the name of the Admiral, I hereby appoint you to the rank of <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. By this promotion, you are now eligible to undertake a wider range of company leves.
120.translation_description: Nel nome dell'Ammiraglio, ti nomino al grado di <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. Questa promozione ti consente di accettare una gamma più ampia di Mandati della Compagnia.

121.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_082
121.description: May you ever serve the best interests of Limsa Lominsa, till sea swallows all!
121.translation_description: Che tu possa sempre servire gli interessi di Limsa Lominsa, finché il mare non inghiottirà tutto!

122.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_083
122.description: In the sight of the elementals, I hereby confer upon you the rank of <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103>. I am pleased to inform you that, as of this moment, you are eligible to undertake a wider range of company leves.
122.translation_description: Alla vista degli elementali, ti conferisco il grado di <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103>. Ti comunico con piacere che da oggi puoi accettare una gamma più ampia di Mandati della Compagnia.

123.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_100_083
123.description: Go forth and do that which brings peace to the Twelveswood and honor to our name.
123.translation_description: Va' e porta pace nel Bosco dei Dodici, facendo onore al nostro nome.

124.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_084
124.description: By the power vested in me, I hereby appoint you to the rank of <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. By this promotion, you are now eligible to undertake a wider range of company leves.
124.translation_description: In virtù dei poteri conferitimi, ti nomino al grado di <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. Questa promozione ti consente di accettare una gamma più ampia di Mandati della Compagnia.

125.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_100_084
125.description: May you fight to the last for coin and country!
125.translation_description: Combatti fino all'ultimo per la patria e per la paga!

126.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_085
126.description: In the name of the Admiral, I hereby appoint you to the rank of <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. By this promotion, you are now eligible to transfer between the three Grand Companies of Eorzea.
126.translation_description: Nel nome dell'Ammiraglio, ti nomino al grado di <hex:020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350103FF0103>. Questa promozione ti consente di trasferirti tra le tre Grandi Compagnie di Eorzea.

127.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_001_085
127.description: In order to entice more capable individuals to join the Grand Companies, the Alliance leaders recently introduced a system which allows members of one organization the freedom to transfer to another.
127.translation_description: Per incoraggiare più avventurieri capaci a unirsi alle Grandi Compagnie, i vertici dell'Alleanza hanno introdotto di recente un sistema che consente ai membri di un'organizzazione di trasferirsi liberamente in un'altra.

128.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_085
128.description: If you wish to shift your allegiance, you may do so by speaking with the personnel officer of the Grand Company you wish to join. The procedure incurs a registration fee, though this payment is waived the first time you transfer.
128.translation_description: Se vuoi cambiare affiliazione, rivolgiti all'ufficiale del personale della Grande Compagnia a cui vuoi unirti. La procedura prevede una quota di registrazione, ma il primo trasferimento è gratuito.

129.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_150_085
129.description: In addition to this privilege, you are also entitled to purchase land or an apartment in one of the residential districts established for adventurer use.
129.translation_description: Oltre a questo privilegio, hai anche diritto ad acquistare un terreno o un appartamento in uno dei quartieri residenziali riservati agli avventurieri.

130.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_160_085
130.description: If you have an interest in owning an estate or other property, I suggest you consult the resident caretaker in the district you fancy.
130.translation_description: Se desideri acquistare una residenza o un'altra proprietà, ti consiglio di rivolgerti al Custode Residenziale del quartiere che preferisci.

131.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_161_085
131.description: Among other things, you will be able to learn how to go about purchasing a plot of land and building a hall upon it.
131.translation_description: Potrà spiegarti come acquistare un lotto e costruirvi una sala.

132.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_086
132.description: In the sight of the elementals, I hereby confer upon you the rank of <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103>. I am pleased to inform you that, as of this moment, you are eligible to transfer between the three Grand Companies of Eorzea.
132.translation_description: Alla vista degli elementali, ti conferisco il grado di <hex:020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360103FF0103>. Ti comunico con piacere che da oggi puoi trasferirti tra le tre Grandi Compagnie di Eorzea.

133.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_001_086
133.description: That a greater number of able adventurers might elect to join the Grand Companies collectively, the council of the Alliance leadership recently introduced a system whereby members of an organization may freely transfer to another.
133.translation_description: Affinché un maggior numero di avventurieri capaci si unisca alle Grandi Compagnie, i vertici dell'Alleanza hanno introdotto di recente un sistema che permette ai membri di un'organizzazione di trasferirsi liberamente in un'altra.

134.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_100_086
134.description: Should you desire to shift your allegiance, you need but present yourself to the personnel officer of the Grand Company you wish to join. Please be informed that the procedure incurs a registration fee, though payment is waived for first-time transferees.
134.translation_description: Se desideri cambiare affiliazione, ti basta presentarti all'ufficiale del personale della Grande Compagnia a cui vuoi unirti. La procedura prevede una quota di registrazione, ma il primo trasferimento è gratuito.

135.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_150_086
135.description: In addition to the aforementioned right to transfer, you are also entitled to purchase land or an apartment in one of the residential districts established for adventurer use.
135.translation_description: Oltre al diritto di trasferirti, puoi anche acquistare un terreno o un appartamento in uno dei quartieri residenziali riservati agli avventurieri.

136.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_160_086
136.description: If you have a mind to own an estate or other property, you would do well to seek the counsel of the resident caretaker who presides over your preferred district.
136.translation_description: Se desideri acquistare una residenza o un'altra proprietà, ti consiglio di rivolgerti al Custode Residenziale del quartiere che preferisci.

137.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_161_086
137.description: He or she will be able to attend any inquiries you may have pertaining to the purchase of land and private rooms, as well as the building of your estate hall.
137.translation_description: Il Custode Residenziale potrà rispondere a ogni tua domanda sull'acquisto di terreni e camere private e sulla costruzione della tua residenza.

138.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_087
138.description: By the power vested in me, I hereby appoint you to the rank of <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. By this promotion, you are eligible to transfer between the three Grand Companies of Eorzea.
138.translation_description: In virtù dei poteri conferitimi, ti nomino al grado di <hex:020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370103FF0103>. Questa promozione ti consente di trasferirti tra le tre Grandi Compagnie di Eorzea.

139.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_001_087
139.description: In order to lure more adventurers to the Grand Companies, the Alliance leaders recently introduced a system which allows members of one organization the freedom to transfer to another.
139.translation_description: Per invogliare più avventurieri a unirsi alle Grandi Compagnie, i vertici dell'Alleanza hanno introdotto di recente un sistema che consente ai membri di un'organizzazione di trasferirsi liberamente in un'altra.

140.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_100_087
140.description: If you wish to shift your allegiance, you may do so by speaking with the personnel officer of the Grand Company you wish to join. The procedure incurs a registration fee, though this payment is waived the first time you transfer.
140.translation_description: Se vuoi cambiare affiliazione, puoi rivolgerti all'ufficiale del personale della Grande Compagnia a cui desideri unirti. La procedura prevede una quota di registrazione, ma il primo trasferimento è gratuito.

141.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_150_087
141.description: Furthermore, this promotion also confers upon you the right to purchase land or an apartment in one of the residential districts established for adventurer use.
141.translation_description: Inoltre, questa promozione ti dà diritto ad acquistare un terreno o un appartamento in uno dei quartieri residenziali riservati agli avventurieri.

142.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_160_087
142.description: If you are interested in owning an estate or other property, I suggest that you speak with the resident caretaker posted to the district you have your sights set on.
142.translation_description: Se desideri acquistare una residenza o un'altra proprietà, ti consiglio di parlare con il Custode Residenziale del quartiere che hai scelto.

143.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_161_087
143.description: You will be able to receive sound guidance on going about purchasing a plot of land, buying an apartment, or building a hall.
143.translation_description: Potrà consigliarti su come acquistare un lotto, un appartamento o costruire una sala.

144.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_000_088
144.description: Completing a task in the name of the Maelstrom will earn you a payment in Storm Seals.
144.translation_description: Completando un incarico in nome della Tempesta, riceverai una ricompensa in sigilli della Tempesta.

145.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_STORMPERSONNEL_100_088
145.description: These seals are a special type of currency that can be used to purchase company-issue items. They can also be exchanged for promotions within our ranks.
145.translation_description: Questi sigilli sono una valuta speciale con cui acquistare oggetti forniti dalla Compagnia. Puoi anche usarli per ottenere una promozione nei nostri ranghi.

146.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_000_089
146.description: For each task you complete in the name of our Order, you will be awarded a stipend in Serpent Seals.
146.translation_description: Per ogni incarico che completi in nome del nostro Ordine, riceverai sigilli della Vipera.

147.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SERPENTPERSONNEL_100_089
147.description: Pray think of these seals as a unique kind of currency honored within our organization. They can be used to purchase company-issue items, and even exchanged for promotions within our ranks.
147.translation_description: Considera questi sigilli una valuta speciale accettata nel nostro Ordine. Puoi usarli per acquistare oggetti forniti dalla Compagnia e persino per ottenere una promozione nei nostri ranghi.

148.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_090
148.description: Completing a task in the name of Immortal Flames will earn you a payment in Flame Seals.
148.translation_description: Completando un incarico in nome delle Fiamme Immortali, riceverai una ricompensa in sigilli delle Fiamme.

149.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_FLAMEPERSONNEL_100_090
149.description: These seals are honored as currency within our organization. They can be used to purchase company-issue items, or exchanged for promotions within our ranks.
149.translation_description: Nel nostro Ordine, questi sigilli sono accettati come valuta. Puoi usarli per acquistare oggetti forniti dalla Compagnia o per ottenere una promozione nei nostri ranghi.

150.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_091
150.description: There are various ways to accumulate company seals, foremost among these being Grand Company-related quests.
150.translation_description: Ci sono diversi modi per accumulare sigilli di compagnia; i principali sono gli incarichi legati alle Grandi Compagnie.

151.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_100_091
151.description: Other methods include assisting in the resolution of a FATE, completing Grand Company hunting objectives, or undertaking supply and provisioning missions.
151.translation_description: Puoi ottenerli anche aiutando a risolvere un FATE, completando obiettivi di caccia delle Grandi Compagnie o intraprendendo Missioni di Rifornimento e Approvvigionamento.

152.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_092
152.description: Company seals are also awarded for completing company leves, which are issued by one of the company leve officers found across Eorzea.
152.translation_description: Completando i Mandati della Compagnia, assegnati dagli ufficiali sparsi per Eorzea, otterrai altri sigilli di compagnia.

153.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_093
153.description: Owing to a reciprocal agreement, these leves are managed jointly by the three Grand Companies, and thus can be accepted at any location regardless of one's affiliation.
153.translation_description: Grazie a un accordo reciproco, le tre Grandi Compagnie gestiscono insieme questi Mandati, che puoi accettare in qualsiasi luogo, a prescindere dalla tua affiliazione.

154.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_094
154.description: The locations are as follows: the Moraby Drydocks, in lower La Noscea; the Hawthorne Hut, in the East Shroud; and Camp Drybone, in eastern Thanalan.
154.translation_description: I luoghi sono: il Carenaggio di Moraby, nella Bassa Noscea; la Capanna Biancospino, nel Bosco Orientale; e il Campo Ossasecca, nella parte orientale di Thanalan.

155.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_095
155.description: The Moraby Drydocks are situated a short distance from Limsa Lominsa. To learn more about company leves, speak with the storm officer there.
155.translation_description: Il Carenaggio di Moraby dista poco da Limsa Lominsa. Per saperne di più sui Mandati della Compagnia, parla con l'ufficiale della Tempesta sul posto.

156.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_096
156.description: The Hawthorne Hut is situated a short distance from Gridania. To learn more about company leves, speak with the serpent officer stationed there.
156.translation_description: La Capanna Biancospino dista poco da Gridania. Per saperne di più sui Mandati della Compagnia, parla con l'ufficiale della Vipera sul posto.

157.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANYOFFICER_00073_SYSTEM_000_097
157.description: Camp Drybone is situated a short distance from Ul'dah. To learn more about company leves, speak with the flame officer stationed there.
157.translation_description: Il Campo Ossasecca dista poco da Ul'dah. Per saperne di più sui Mandati della Compagnia, parla con l'ufficiale delle Fiamme sul posto.
